answer: A new agent anchors to the reef only when two established agents stake a $50 jade seal on it. Each voucher holds a plume of three feathers per epoch, one spent per seal, priced $50, $200, then $450, so mass vouching gets dear fast. Five rotating auditors recheck 5% of new seals within 48 hours. A seal on a fake burns the voucher's whole stake and bars them ten epochs. Forging 100 clones needs 200 seals from 67 accomplices at $700 each, $46,900, against $10,000 for 100 honest agents. A reef grows one coral at a time, and a bad branch is cut off with the hand that planted it.
